items.headline: 9 亿多个星系，怎样画成立体地图？
items.headline_en: Turning 900 Million Galaxies into a 3D Map
items.summary: 11 月 12 日，欧洲航天局公开欧几里得望远镜首批大型数据，汇集约 13 个月观测，收录 9 亿多个星系。照片给出星系在天空中的方向；星光的红移提供距离线索。把方向和距离结合起来，便能描出星系在三维空间的分布，研究宇宙结构如何长成。
items.summary_en: On November 12, ESA released Euclid’s first major batch of data, covering about 13 months of observations and more than 900 million galaxies. Images show where galaxies lie on the sky; the redshift of their light gives clues to their distance. Combining direction and distance helps map galaxies in three dimensions and study how cosmic structure grew.

items.headline: 厄尔尼诺增强，太平洋雨带随之改变
items.headline_en: A Stronger El Niño Shifts Pacific Rainfall
items.summary: 11 月 12 日，美国气候预测中心报告，赤道东太平洋部分海面比常年暖逾 4°C。暖海面利于湿空气上升；赤道中、东太平洋的对流和降雨偏强，印度尼西亚一带对流偏弱。该中心估计，强至很强的厄尔尼诺延续到 2027 年 1 至 3 月的概率超过 79%。
items.summary_en: On November 12, the US Climate Prediction Center reported that parts of the eastern equatorial Pacific were more than 4°C warmer than usual. Warm seas favour rising moist air: convection and rainfall were above normal over the central and eastern equatorial Pacific, while convection stayed weak around Indonesia. The centre puts the chance of a strong to very strong El Niño persisting through January–March 2027 above 79%.

items.headline: 旱地为什么长出「精灵圈」？
items.headline_en: Why Do “Fairy Circles” Form in Drylands?
items.summary: 11 月 11 日发表的研究首次记录中国北方旱区的「精灵圈」：植被围成一圈，中央却裸露。研究者结合野外调查和电脑模型，发现草本植物与灌木竞争水分，可以使灌丛中央先变稀，留下环形边缘。地表的花纹由此成为理解旱地植物如何争夺水分的线索。
items.summary_en: A study published on November 11 documented the first known fairy circles in northern China’s drylands: rings of vegetation with bare centres. Combining field surveys with computer modelling, researchers showed how competition for water between grasses and shrubs could thin the centre of a shrub patch, leaving a ring. The pattern offers a clue to how dryland plants compete for water.

items.headline: 轻轻拉伸，石墨烯的电阻就变了
items.headline_en: A Small Stretch Changes Graphene’s Resistance
items.summary: 11 月 12 日，华盛顿大学团队报告：两片各只有一个原子厚的石墨烯稍微错转，原子网格就会叠出更大的图案，像两层纱网。在低温实验里，轻微拉伸或压缩样品，电阻便明显改变。除了换成别的材料，改变材料的形状也能调节它的导电特性。
items.summary_en: On November 12, a University of Washington team reported that slightly twisting two sheets of graphene, each one atom thick, creates a larger pattern like two overlapping screens. At low temperatures, gently stretching or compressing the sample markedly changed its resistance. Changing a material’s shape, rather than its ingredients, offers another way to tune how it conducts electricity.

items.headline: 玉米怎样把微量的镍送进籽粒？
items.headline_en: How Does Maize Get Nickel into Its Kernels?
items.summary: 北京时间 11 月 11 日发表的研究发现，玉米用转运蛋白把一种叫烟胺的小分子送出细胞。烟胺与镍结合，帮助镍从茎叶运往籽粒。镍能让脲酶正常工作，帮助植物利用尿素中的氮。这解释了为什么只需微量的镍，也会影响种子活力和产量。
items.summary_en: In a study published on November 11 Beijing time, researchers found that maize uses a transporter to export a small molecule called nicotianamine. It binds nickel, helping move the metal from stems and leaves to kernels. Nickel enables urease to work, helping the plant use nitrogen from urea. This explains why even a trace amount of nickel can matter for seed vigour and yield.

items.headline: 海底滑坡，也会慢慢垮
items.headline_en: An Underwater Landslide Can Fail Slowly
items.summary: 11 月 12 日发表的研究用声呐和传感器记录了加拿大霍马斯科河三角洲的天然海底滑坡。砂粒分开时，孔隙水压先下降，暂时稳住斜坡；水压恢复后，沉积物逐步崩落，混着水沿海底流出数公里。这意味着海底电缆不能只防瞬间冲击，也要考虑持续较久的滑坡作用。
items.summary_en: A study published on November 12 used sonar and sensors to record natural underwater landslides at Canada’s Homathko Delta. As sand grains moved apart, water pressure between them dropped, briefly stabilising the slope. As pressure recovered, sediment gradually collapsed and flowed kilometres along the seabed mixed with water. Seabed cables therefore need protection against prolonged forces as well as sudden impacts.

previous_answers.headline: 选一个三位数，要求百位与个位相差至少2。把它的数字顺序倒过来，用较大的数减去较小的数。再把所得差的数字顺序倒过来，将这两个数相加。不必知道最初选的数，你能预测最后的结果吗？说明理由。（倒序后开头的0可以略去。）
previous_answers.headline_en: Choose a three-digit number whose first and last digits differ by at least 2. Reverse its digits, then subtract the smaller number from the larger. Reverse the digits of the difference and add these two numbers. Can you predict the final total without knowing the starting number? Explain why. Any leading zero in a reversed number may be omitted.
previous_answers.explanation: 设首尾数字之差为 d，则减出的数是 99d，三位数字依次为 d−1、9、10−d。倒序相加时，两端各凑成 9，中间相加得 18；进位后就是 1089。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Let d be the difference between the first and last digits. Subtracting gives 99d, whose digits are d−1, 9 and 10−d. Adding its reversal gives 9 at both ends and 18 in the middle before carrying, which gives 1,089.
previous_answers.subject: W46 · 倒序数之谜解答

previous_answers.headline: 12张卡片分别写着1至12。充分洗匀后，随机抽出3张，不放回。三张卡片上的数之和能被3整除的概率是多少？请用清楚的分类计数说明答案，而不是只靠模拟。
previous_answers.headline_en: Twelve cards are numbered 1 to 12. Shuffle them thoroughly and draw three without replacement. What is the probability that their sum is divisible by 3? Explain your answer by counting cases, rather than relying only on a simulation.
previous_answers.explanation: 按除以 3 的余数分三类，每类 4 张。要使和整除，三张的余数要么全相同，要么各不相同。符合的组合有 3×4＋4³＝76 种；一共 220 种，所以是 76/220＝19/55。
previous_answers.explanation_en: There are four cards in each remainder class modulo 3. For the sum to be divisible by 3, the remainders must be all equal or all different. This gives 3×4 + 4³ = 76 valid triples out of 220, so the probability is 19/55.
previous_answers.subject: W46 · 余数与概率解答

previous_answers.headline: 7名选手进行单循环比赛：每两人恰好比赛一场，每场都有一名胜者，没有平局。证明：无论比赛结果如何，总能把7人排成一列，使每个人都赢过紧挨在自己后面的人。注意：不要求一个人赢过自己后面的所有人。
previous_answers.headline_en: Seven players compete in a round-robin tournament: every pair plays exactly once, and every match has one winner, with no draws. Prove that, whatever the results, the players can always be arranged in a line so that each player beat the person immediately after them. A player need not have beaten everyone farther down the line.
previous_answers.explanation: 先排一人，再逐个加入。新选手若谁也没赢过，就放在末尾；否则把他插到队中第一位被他打败的人前面。若前面还有一人，那人一定赢过新选手，所以两个新的相邻关系都成立。
previous_answers.explanation_en: Start with one player and add the rest one at a time. If the newcomer beat nobody in the line, put them at the end. Otherwise, insert them just before the first player they beat. Any player immediately before that position must have beaten the newcomer, so both new links work.
previous_answers.subject: W46 · 胜者队列解答
